### In 2025, the TDCC-NES funded The CAFE (Code Along, Feel Empowered) Method project.

::: {.callout-note}
Scroll down to find dates & location of the roadshow!
:::

The project aims to create a national network of Programming Cafes using the CAFE method, providing resources, guidance, and a community-building framework to enhance coding literacy among programmers in research. To achieve these goals, the project will expand the existing CAFE Playbook with strategies for starting and managing cafes, organize roadshow and kickstart events to engage new members, and create reusable session materials to facilitate continuous learning and collaboration.

> "With this funding, we aim to establish programming CAFÉs in universities nationwide, creating accessible and welcoming spaces for learning and exchanging knowledge.” - Aleksandra Wilczynska, 4TU.ResearchData Project leader

### CAFE Roadshow

In 2026, the WP2 leads are organizing a roadshow to share information about the CAFE playbook and stimulate the creation of new CAFEs.
